name: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location. Students and educators can schedule through Certiport.

exam.format: Proctored 45-minute exam through Pearson VUE (Certiport for students and educators); interactive components may appear. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

scope: Cloud concepts, Azure architecture and core services (compute, networking, storage, identity and security), and Azure cost, governance, management and monitoring tools.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for AZ-900; practice runs here are paced on 40 questions in 45 minutes.

prep.title: Microsoft Learn: Azure Fundamentals course (AZ-900T00)
prep.note: Self-paced learning paths for the three skill areas; the instructor-led delivery is paid.

prep.title: Official AZ-900 practice assessment
prep.note: On AI Skills Navigator; needs a sign-in.

domains_note: Weights are the midpoints of the ranges in the Microsoft Learn AZ-900 study guide (25–30%, 35–40%, 30–35%; skills measured as of July 20, 2026), scaled to add up to 100. Read 2026-11-17.
